rules.설명: Lode MCP tool: the name of an operation registry row (the row's own name, not the nested tool definition). A tool call enters through the MCP dispatcher (dispatch and the two steps after it, named apart because the scan gives dispatch and dispatchSessionRequest a one-line range).

Lode CLI command: the command of an operation registry row's cli block (not a command named inside a result). A command enters through the CLI dispatcher (runCommand and runSpelledCommand, named apart because the scan gives runCommand a one-line range).
Lode CLI command alias: each name in a registry row's cli.aliases list. An alias enters through the CLI dispatcher.
